news.title: Embassy Developments to invest ₹2,000 crore in 85-acre Bengaluru housing project
news.para: Embassy Developments has launched Embassy Origins, an 85-acre residential development in North Bengaluru. The first phase includes Embassy Riverine and Embassy South Reserve, with a combined GDV of about ₹4,500 crore.

news.title: Higher price tags for Bhubaneswar development body's homes; middle class in a fix
news.para: The Bhubaneswar Development Authority has transitioned its housing projects towards luxury amenities, resulting in a sharp increase in prices. This change is leaving many middle-income families struggling to afford homes in the city, as apartment sizes fail to keep pace with soaring costs. Factors such as rising land values and construction expenses are driving these price hikes, though the authority plans to roll out affordable housing options soon.

news.title: Sonu Nigam sells pre-leased retail property in Mumbai's BKC for ₹18 crore
news.para: The 3,082 sq ft retail unit at Trade Centre, Bandra Kurla Complex, has been sold to SAA Estate LLP. The property is leased to Down Town 29 at a monthly rent of ₹20 lakh, translating to ₹2.4 crore in annualised rental income.

news.title: CBRE South Asia to integrate Propstack’s real estate analytics platform
news.para: Propstack has entered into a strategic enterprise agreement with CBRE South Asia. Under the partnership, CBRE will integrate Propstack’s data and analytics platform across its India operations to support market intelligence, investment analysis and client advisory.

news.title: Ghaziabad: Indirapuram highrise residents seek action on encroachment, transport, fire safety
news.para: Indirapuram societies came together for a community meeting focused on urgent civic and safety challenges. Central to their discussion were issues like unlawful encroachments, insufficient public transport options, and the pressing need for enhanced fire safety in aging buildings. Addressing traffic congestion and poor civic services, residents called for administrative intervention for infrastructure enhancement and better metro connectivity.

news.title: Calcutta high court orders NKDA to raze illegal buildings in New Town complex
news.para: The Calcutta High Court ruled Rosedale Plaza is not independent from residential units. NKDA was directed to demolish construction outside the plaza's purchased area. The court found the plaza and residential complex are part of a singular housing project. Commercial hubs were conceptualized as common facilities for residents. Apartment owners will regain common areas occupied by the plaza owner.

news.title: Maharashtra's MahaBhumi Stack digital gateway now offers property ownership details
news.para: Home buyers in Maharashtra can now verify land ownership through a new digital platform. The MahaBhumi Stack consolidates multiple government land records, offering a user-friendly interface for property checks. This innovation allows citizens to access information on ownership, transaction history, and revenue court conditions efficiently, promoting transparency and combating property fraud effectively.

news.title: Delhi development body moves to hasten redevelopment of old group housing societies
news.para: In a bid to modernize old housing societies, the Delhi Development Authority is currently deliberating on redevelopment plans. The updated master plan includes provisions to increase density in these neighborhoods. Residents have expressed worries about the size of units and the potential for increased commercialization. To address these concerns, the authority intends to bolster infrastructure and improve public services in the area.

news.title: Legal hurdles & fund crunch delaying stalled Supertech projects
news.para: NBCC is grappling with significant funding and legal challenges in its attempt to finalize the Supertech projects. The Supreme Court has taken up NBCC's appeal against Rera financial compliance standards, while the NCLAT has denied NBCC's request for exceptions from these regulations. Meanwhile, homebuyers are voicing their frustrations over the lack of progress, as construction has yet to commence, despite the Supreme Court's previous decisions to approve the project revival.

news.title: Noida authority orders structural audit of Great Value Sharnam
news.para: In response to continuous complaints, the Noida Authority has directed a structural audit for the Great Value Sharnam project. Residents have noted peeling plaster and exposed reinforcement bars across various towers and in the basement area. Upon inspection, evidence of water leakage and seepage on columns and beams was discovered. The developer is obliged to inspect and repair any structural issues immediately.

news.title: New Zealand housing market slows in August 2026 as buyers adopt wait-and-see approach
news.para: Home prices in New Zealand dipped in August, reflecting the impact of economic pressures on buyer sentiment. There was a notable median price drop of 1.3% from July, as well as from the same period last year. Furthermore, home sales across the nation declined, with properties remaining on the market for extended periods. Conversely, the South Island showed relative strength compared to its northern counterpart.

news.title: Home prices in China stay weak, keeping pressure on economy
news.para: China's property market faced another setback in August as home prices dropped again, highlighting a protracted downturn. Major tier-one cities exhibit some degree of stabilization, but smaller markets are still grappling with falling prices. To counter this, the government is introducing measures to revive buyer confidence and adjust developer financing.

news.title: Odisha RERA asks promoters to furnish updated occupancy, CC details within 30 days
news.para: The Odisha Real Estate Regulatory Authority has set new guidelines requiring promoters to upload updated certificates within thirty days of receipt. Non-compliance could lead to penalties and potential restrictions on property registration. Additionally, promoters seeking approval must present proof of application and payment. This initiative is designed to promote transparency and safeguard the interests of homebuyers.

news.title: Suraksha Group to invest ₹3,000 crore to complete pending Jaypee towers by September 2028
news.para: Suraksha Group, which acquired Jaypee Infratech, has invested about ₹1,500-2,000 crore so far in construction and expects to invest another ₹3,000 crore to complete the remaining towers by September 2028. The company has also outlined plans for three integrated townships across about 465 acres.

news.title: Reliance MET City appoints Manish Jaiswal as CEO; Embassy Developments names Neel Virwani as CBO
news.para: Reliance MET City has appointed Manish Jaiswal as chief executive officer to lead its business and growth strategy. Embassy Developments has appointed Neel Virwani as chief business officer, effective October 1, 2026, to drive expansion across North and West India.

news.title: Andhra Pradesh government to set up special cell to clear hurdles to high-rise building plans
news.para: The state government is enhancing the approval process for tall buildings by establishing a specialized unit for applications pertaining to structures with five or more floors. This initiative seeks to expedite review timelines and minimize holdups for developers. Authorities are tasked with addressing existing software issues and promoting transparency. These reforms are designed to invigorate the construction and real estate sectors statewide.

news.title: Convert B khata to A until end of 2027: Karnataka government
news.para: Karnataka government has authorized the conversion of eligible 'B' Khata properties to 'A' Khata. This new mechanism will be implemented by urban and rural development departments until December 2027. Properties up to 1,000 square meters with proposed non-agricultural use are covered by this order. Specific cut-off dates apply for properties in urban and rural local bodies respectively.

news.title: Housing project in Haryana’s Sultanpur park buffer zone seeks fresh wildlife clearance
news.para: A developer is pursuing wildlife clearance for a new housing development close to Sultanpur National Park. This comes on the heels of a committee uncovering multiple infractions within the eco-sensitive region. The firm claims that their project aligns with the zonal master plan. However, environmental advocates argue that existing violations must be addressed before any further construction can be approved.

news.title: Chandigarh administration proposes 50% rate for freehold conversion
news.para: The Chandigarh administration has put forth a proposal to transition leasehold properties into freehold status. The conversion charges will be set at fifty percent of the collector rate, while properties acquired through auctions will incur a twenty-five percent fee. This initiative has been forwarded to the Ministry of Home Affairs, and the administration is now awaiting its review and approval.

news.title: Green future: Cement makers accelerate decarbonisation push
news.para: In a significant shift towards sustainability, Indian cement manufacturers are enhancing the use of green energy and implementing efficiency improvements. By adopting waste heat recovery systems, these firms are not only curbing energy usage but also lowering operational costs. Additionally, they are expanding their renewable energy capacities, aligning with long-term carbon reduction goals, while exploring innovative carbon capture technologies for future integration.
